hypothesis: A unique repeated peer single-positive-scalar candidate may recover coverage but can erase undocumented business exceptions.
base: immutable dev6 behavior with dev8 corrected metadata
candidate_rule: exactly one positive multiplicative literal insertion/removal/replacement; local references, arithmetic only
acceptance_rule: at least two matching candidate peers and strict majority of all present peers; same header signatures; no marked target/peer policy scope
preservation: all existing dev6 proposals retained; all error and clean-control denominators retained
ordering: write source and tests then freeze; predict all cases; lock predictions; separate-process score; exact replay
interpretation: Peer majority is correlated evidence, never business correctness proof; development gains alone cannot qualify final model.
